text:
carla_partnerops: quick flag — SI partner 'GreenScale' is sending usage events with missing plan_id mapping; looks like ~4% of daily events failing entitlement match. Not sure if it's new schema from them or our ingest. cc @ben_dev

ben_dev: ack — can you paste an example payload?

carla_partnerops: ```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_3f2a1",
  "partner_id": "gs-01",
  "partner_plan": "standard",
  "plan_id": "",
  "usage_units": 1200,
  "timestamp": "2026-03-19T02:12:03Z",
  "user_id": "u_9876"
}
```

alice_ng: saw similar earlier — our webhook parser tolerates unknown keys but plan_id is empty string for some events. This causes us to fall back to default free plan and underbill.

frank_eng: FYI deploy-bot showed webhook-delivery spikes for greenscale around the same time, could be partial duplication/loss scenario.

deploy-bot: System: 15 failed deliveries for webhook greenscale/usage in last 30m. Last failure: 502 Bad Gateway. Logs: s3://redwood-logs/webhook/greenscale/1906003200.log

ben_dev: ok i'll pull the raw logs and run a quick map check. Can someone run a reconciliation for 2026-03-19 to 2026-03-20 where partner_id=gs-01 and plan_id is NULL

emily_finance: urgent — we need estimated revenue impact for tomorrow's partner sync. If underbilled, we'll need a credit memo + partner notification.

frank_eng: query I'll run:
```sql
SELECT event_id, user_id, partner_plan, plan_id, received_at
FROM ingestion.events
WHERE partner_id='gs-01' AND (plan_id IS NULL OR plan_id='') AND received_at BETWEEN '2026-03-19' AND '2026-03-20';
```

frank_eng: Also check transformation job transform.partner_plan_map — suspect last deploy dropped a tuple for 'gs-01-standard'

alice_ng: if mapping missing, temporary mitigation: map unknown -> 'gs-01-standard' at ingestion layer (config flag) then run backfill

carla_partnerops: agree. Can we do soft fix first and backfill next weekend? Partner prefers not to be disturbed during business hrs.

ben_dev: timeline: I'll push config change to ingestion staging in 30m, smoke test, then prod push at 22:00 UTC if green.

emily_finance: please add a reconciliation run plan: 1) identify affected events 2) estimate token counts + $$$ 3) backfill charges 4) draft partner message.

carla_partnerops: drafting partner note. Will include ask to confirm they didn't intentionally change schema. Also ask for export of their raw events for crosscheck.

frank_eng: leaving trace: created ticket INF-5423 mapping-mismatch, assigned to @ben_dev, doc: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-5423

ben_dev: ping me if you see >1k affected events; will open emergency call.

carla_partnerops: thanks team :pray: keep updates here — I'll schedule a cross-team sync at 19:00 UTC to review impact.
